confounds: THE REPRICED LEG IS THE MOVING LEG. 'repriced rungs do not fill' and 'the leg whose price is moving does not fill' are the same observation in this data and cannot be separated by it.
NEITHER RESTING NOR NOT-REPRICING IS SUFFICIENT. C7's YES rung was placed once at 0.01, never repriced, rested 72.1 s, and did not fill. A penny bid left alone is still a penny bid.
n = 5 FILLS, and only three of them have a mutation record. Every share above is over single digits.
ONE WINDOW HAS A BOOK BEHIND EVERY CYCLE. Book-state capture began with C8B, so the per-cycle surroundings below come almost entirely from one window on one day.
PRINTS AT OUR PRICE ARE NOT IN THE RECORD for any existing rung; the live tape reader landed after all of them.

BEING ALONE AT THE TOUCH IS NOT THE SAME AS BEING PATIENT. The one fill with a book behind it stood as the ENTIRE bid, 6 to 19 cents above the next real one, while the offer walked 10 cents down toward it. 'Rested 58 s then filled' and 'was the last bid standing in a falling market' describe the same event, and this record cannot separate them either.

consistency_with_confirmed_credits.caveat: CONSISTENT IS NOT PROVEN. Ineligible fills sit in the denominator and earn nothing, biasing the implied price; this check can only fail to contradict.
